hero.title: Cover for the place that matters most
hero.intro: Buildings and contents cover with accidental damage and Family Legal Protection included as standard, plus up to 30% off with your no claims bonus.

savings.title: Up to 30% off, and more ways to save
savings.intro: We reward low-risk homes and loyal customers. Stack these discounts to bring your premium down.
items: 30%: With 3 or more years no claims bonus
Alarm: Discount where a monitored burglar alarm is fitted
Age 46+: Reduced premium if the proposer is 46 or older
Excess: Choose a €500 or €1,000 voluntary excess to save more

faqs.question: What am I covered for under buildings and contents insurance?
faqs.answer: Typically loss or damage to buildings and contents caused by fire, storm, flood, escape of water and theft. Accidental damage to buildings and contents is included as standard, and a full summary of covers is available on request.
